retriever: MLX GPU 512d float16 exact scan, top100, no cutoff
protocol: Same cached dev queries; no training or qrels given to reranker; stable ID tie-break within candidate scores. Retrieval and reranking stages measured separately; combined values are sums, not a timed deployed endpoint. One warmup query for reranker. Tokenization, model inference and synchronization included; loading excluded. No paid API calls.
limitations: Selected reused 100-query sample, not held out for project tuning.
Model pretrained on MS MARCO training data; split overlap with this expanded dev sample has not been independently audited.
Sequences longer than 512 tokens are truncated.
Candidate retrieval runs with MLX and cross-encoder with PyTorch MPS; production memory and concurrency not measured.
